translations.translatedText: # Monday 1.10.2018 (radio)

Kela is paying reduced social assistance to more and more people. The Confederation of Finnish Industries, EK, has published a proposal on employment. There are already 1.45 million people in Finland who do not belong to any religion. The Nobel Prize in Medicine has been awarded. Singer Charles Aznavour has died.
## Social assistance has been reduced for many
![Persons who received reduced basic social assistance, 2017-2018.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10415250)
Open image viewer
Kela pays reduced social assistance to more and more people. The reason is usually refusing work or training.
This year, more than 11,000 people's social assistance has been cut by 100 to 200 euros. Many reduction decisions have been made since social assistance moved from the municipalities to Kela.
However, Kela says that only about 1.5 percent of social assistance recipients receive reduced assistance.
## EK published its own employment proposal
![A woman on her way to a TE Office.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10368458)
Open image viewer
EK's employment target is higher than the government's target. Photo: Mikko Stig / Lehtikuva
The Confederation of Finnish Industries, EK, has published a proposal on employment. The employers' organisation EK believes that its proposal will improve employment.

EK, for example, wants the duration of earnings-related unemployment allowance to be shortened by 50 days. At the same time, the allowance could be higher at the early stage of unemployment. In addition, EK wants day care fees to be lowered.
With its proposal EK aims for 75 percent employment. The Finnish government's target is 72 percent.
## Over a million people in Finland do not belong to a religious community
![Street scene from Espoo.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10432046)
Open image viewer
The number of people who do not belong to a religious community is increasing. However, not everyone's religion is officially known. Photo: AOP
In Finland a quarter of people do not belong to any registered religious community. Among men, 30 percent were such last year, and among women 23 percent.
At the end of last year there were already 1.45 million people who did not belong to a religion. Among foreign-language speakers, 85 percent do not belong to any religion.
However, not all religious communities are in the register. In addition, many religious practitioners do not join any parish. This is what Statistics Finland says.
## The medical Nobel goes to cancer researchers
![On the stage's backdrop cloth are pictures of Nobel laureates. In the foreground three people sit.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10433473)
Open image viewer
James P. Allison and Tasuku Honjo will be awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine. Photo: Fredrik Sandberg / EPA
The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine has been awarded. It goes to the American James P. Allison and the Japanese Tasuku Honjo.
They have developed a new method for treating cancer. It uses the human immune defence.
## Singer Charles Aznavour has died
![Charles Aznavour.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10432869)
Open image viewer
Aznavour's interpretations include, for example, the chanson classic La Bohème and Emmenez-moi, which is about longing for distant places. Photo: Valentin Flauraud / EPA
French-Armenian singer Charles Aznavour has died at the age of 94.
Aznavour sang in seven languages. The singer, a legend, toured performance stages until the end, despite his high age. His tour in Japan became Aznavour's last.
Aznavour was born in Paris. Both of his parents fled Turkey because of the Armenian genocide. Aznavour took Armenian citizenship in 2008. He was also Armenia's ambassador in Switzerland.
